Name: Daily Planner (old version)
Author: MevNav
Description:
[center][b]Current version: 1.2.0
Last Update: May 24th, 2023


[/b][/center]I had originally released this mod half-finished way back in 2019... and then promptly forgot about it while I was distracted for years with college work. In the meantime, it broke after a few game updates, and remained broken for several years.

The mod is now fixed after many years of being abandoned, and in an actually finished and usable state, however, rather than stick to this particular Nexus page, I decided to recreate the mod with a new page. From now on, all future updates will be uploaded on this mod page:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16704]Daily Planner at Stardew Valley Nexus

[/url]The manifest for the version uploaded on this particular page ﻿now points to this new Nexus page, just in case you decide to download this regardless, so SMAPI should let you know if a version higher than 1.2.0 ever gets released (which is likely, because there's still stuff I want to add/fix).

Downloads.Description: Example of how to make a checklist in .txt format. Put in your Mods/DailyPlanner/Plans folder.

The final version of this mod to be released on this page. All future updates will be on the new nexus page at:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16704
